criteria.description: Inference deployment form accepts an optional pinned worker and includes pinned_worker in placement policy.
Inference deployment form previews eligible and rejected workers with reasons and an estimated eligible worker count before submit.
Inference deployment supports label selector, worker selector, and rollout label inputs for deploy targeting.
Existing inference endpoint pinning publishes workload.pin.request through publishCommand and waits for worker result events.
Environment placement policy editing publishes worker-policy.apply.request through publishCommand and waits for worker result events.
Frontend control-plane subscriptions include worker state and eligibility read-model kinds.
